basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old tech enthusiast from Seattle, currently working as a junior software developer. My interests include science fiction movies, particularly the Star Wars saga, and building custom PC setups. I spend most evenings online, usually after 8 PM, diving into new hobbies or catching up on the latest tech trends. I'm single and enjoy exploring local tech meetups on weekends. Dislikes include poor customer service and overpriced gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge stems mainly from self-teaching and online courses. I have a degree in Computer Science, which fuels my passion for technology and innovation. I often find myself researching the latest in consumer electronics and gaming.
